name: Simple Subterfugin'
label: Quest
description: Simple Subterfugin': the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Ye see, the King be strip mining the quarry fer ore and gems. More riches than any one dwarf should see in ten lifetimes.
The Hidden Circle has values, friend. We value valuables. Can ye understand?
Now we feels the King should be sharing some of that booty, but we don't want ol' 'Stinkbeard' to know he's sharin' - if ye catch me drift.
We needs ye to speak with Onin MacHammar over by Gnomeregan and bring back a report. The crafty dwarf has hidden hisself amongst the lepers. Be careful.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Shhhh! Keep it down you daft fool. They'll hear us.
